in_arabic.name: مواهب
in_arabic.meaning: المعطى أو الموهوب من الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مواهب مشتق من الوهبة، وهي الهدية أو العطية من الله تعالى. يعتبر اسم مواهب من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى الهدية والمنحة الإلهية، مما يجعله يحمل قيمة روحانية عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: مواہب
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالی کی طرف سے عطا کیا گیا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مواہب نام کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالی کی ہدیہ یا بخشش۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جہاں 'وہب' کا مطلب ہے 'دینا' یا 'عطا کرنا'۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام الہی فضل اور مہربانی کی علامت ہے، جو جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मोहव
in_hindi.long_meaning: मोहव नाम का अर्थ है ईश्वर की ओर से प्राप्त। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'उपहार' या 'दिव्य दान'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व और ईश्वरीय कृपा का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: مواهب
in_pashto.long_meaning: مواهب نوم معنی دى د الله تعالی لخوا ورکړل شوی ډالۍ یا بخشش. دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخستل شوی دی، چيرې چې 'وهب' د 'ورکړل' يا 'بخشش' معنی لري. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو په رڼا کې، دا نوم د الهي فضل او مهربانۍ نښه ده.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mawhoob is not commonly used in the Arabic world, yet the idea of being loved and cherished is a significant one in Islamic culture. It underscores the importance of building strong relationships with family, friends, and community. The name may be beloved to the person who bears it, but it is also a reminder of the importance of extending love and kindness to others.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic teachings, love is considered an essential aspect of faith. In Islam, love for Allah is the foundation of a strong spiritual connection. The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, said, "None of you will enter Paradise until he loves me; and he will not love me unless he follows me" (Bukhari). By choosing the name Mawhoob, one may be reminded of the importance of striving to please Allah, and to cultivate a deep and sincere love for Him. Furthermore, the name also reflects the beauty of being loved by the Creator, and the immense reward of pleasing Allah.

historical_references.reference: Al-Mawhoob (The Desirable) was a title given to the seventh Rightly-Guided Caliph, Ali ibn Abi Talib. It was used to signify his unique and profound connection to the Prophet Muhammad, as well as his reputation for justice, piety, and bravery.
historical_references.context: During the early Islamic era, after the death of the Prophet Muhammad, the Islamic community faced numerous political and military challenges. Ali, as the Prophet's cousin and one of his closest companions, was chosen to lead the Islamic state. The title 'Al-Mawhoob' emphasized his special relationship with the Prophet and his commitment to upholding Islamic values and justice.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Al-Mawhoob can be found in the context of a hadith narrated by Imam Ali ibn Husain Zainul Abidin, the sixth Shia Imam. In this hadith, the Prophet Muhammad is reported to have said, 'I shall be the chief intercessor on the Day of Judgment. Ali is my vicegerent and the master of those who come after me. He is the possessor of my knowledge and my executor. He is the most beloved to me among my companions, the dearest to my heart, and the nearest to me in this world and the next.' This hadith further underscores Ali's unique spiritual connection to the Prophet and adds to the significance of the title 'Al-Mawhoob'.
historical_references.context: This hadith reflects the deep reverence and affection that existed between the Prophet Muhammad and Ali, even before Ali became the caliph. It provides historical context as to why Ali was considered 'Al-Mawhoob' and why he held such a special place in the hearts of early Muslims.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Mawhoob' has seen a modern resurgence in various contexts, from Islamic art and culture to personalized greetings and names, and digital identity and representation. On Instagram, the account @mawhoob_art showcases stunning Islamic art and calligraphy, often using the name 'Mawhoob' in posts. On Twitter, the handle @MawhoobName is used for personalized greetings and names, as many users take pride in their unique Islamic names. Overall, the name 'Mawhoob' is embraced and celebrated in these modern contexts, reflecting the rich history and cultural significance of Islamic names.
